integrity: The bounds are proved by pointwise affine certificates on the parity lattice, and attainability is proved by an explicit exchangeable count construction with exact first two factorial moments. Finite computation is used only to replay formulas and enumerate finite two-point extreme laws.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns equal coefficients only.
It classifies the extremal law of the absolute sum but not every nonsymmetric full joint-law extremizer.
The originality search was targeted and may miss an equivalent formulation in older limited-independence or coding literature.
title: Exact first-absolute-moment spectrum of pairwise-independent fair signs
